description: This file defines the 'ChannelOwner' abstract class which manages the lifecycle, event subscription, and communication over channels in the Playwright core client. It handles object relationships, subscription management, API call wrapping, and integrates with platform-specific logging and instrumentation.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: An abstract class managing lifecycle, event subscriptions, and communication for a channel object in Playwright's core client.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping from event names to protocol subscription event names.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' method to enable subscription upon first listener addition.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'off' to disable subscription when last listener is removed.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, updating parent-child relationships.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes the object, cleaning up references and disposing children.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns debug state including nested objects.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a channel proxy with validation and method wrapping.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with platform-specific, tracing, and error handling logic.
